description: Normative fact-export-v1 schema for the usage table. Captures normalized token accounting deltas (D1, I02), model and effort attribution, observed USD and integer micro-dollars when reported by the harness, and explicit cost provenance/missingness (F14). Enterprise owns contract-price estimates (EN6a).

cache_read_tokens.description: Normalized delta of cached input tokens read during this usage record (0 when none read).

x_justification.why_present: Enables cache efficiency ratio (I02) and cache-aware Enterprise rate-card pricing (EN6a).

cache_write_tokens.description: Normalized delta of cache creation/write tokens during this usage record (0 when none written).

x_justification.why_present: Separates cache write premium tokens from uncached input and cache reads (I02, EN6a).

canonical_harness.description: Canonical harness identifier from the closed link-id-v1 vocabulary.

x_justification.why_present: Partitions token and cost accounting by harness platform.

cost_provenance.description: Explicit provenance for observed_usd / observed_usd_micros. Producer never fabricates rate-card estimates; Enterprise computes contract-price estimates downstream (MVP plan §2 Decision 4, F14).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether observed_usd and observed_usd_micros are non-null ('harness_observed_exact' or 'provider_receipt_exact') vs null ('unknown').
x_justification.why_present: Resolves F14 (cost is NULL in 90-99.9% of local rows) by explicitly separating producer-observed USD from unknown cost that requires Enterprise rate-card estimation.

cost_unknown_reason.description: Explicit reason code when cost_provenance == 'unknown'. Null when cost is observed.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff cost_provenance == 'unknown'; null iff cost_provenance != 'unknown'.
x_justification.why_present: Tells Enterprise why observed USD is missing and whether rate-card pricing should be applied (F14, EN6a).

counter_semantics.description: How the raw harness token counters were normalized into delta counts (accounting_v1).

x_justification.why_present: Preserves auditability of cumulative-to-delta normalization for Codex and Grok cumulative counters (accounting_v1).

effort.description: Normalized reasoning/thinking effort level for the usage record (MVP plan §2 Decision 4).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required closed enum with explicit 'not_applicable' and 'unknown' states.
x_justification.why_present: Distinguishes reasoning effort tiers for cost-efficiency and latency analysis (MVP plan §2 Decision 4).

input_uncached_tokens.description: Normalized delta of uncached input/prompt tokens during this usage record.

x_justification.why_present: Core input token component for I02 token economics and EN6a rate-card valuation.

invocation_key.description: Foreign key to invocations.invocation_key when usage is attributed to a specific turn/invocation.

x_justification.why_present: Joins token and cost deltas to the exact qualified invocation (I01, I02).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether invocation_key is non-null ('linked') vs null ('session_level_summary' or 'unattributed_turn').
x_justification.why_present: Eliminates ambiguity when a harness emits session-level usage summaries without a per-turn invocation ID.

model.description: Sanitized model identifier token when known (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-6', 'gpt-5-codex'). Null when model_status == 'unknown'.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff model_status in ['observed', 'inferred_from_session']; null iff model_status == 'unknown'.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Public model family/release token validated against strict identifier characters; never a filesystem path or user string.
x_justification.why_present: Required for model attribution, replaceable within a generation when late turn metadata resolves an unknown model, and used by EN6a rate cards.
x_justification.zero_content: Strict model identifier token without whitespace or paths (DE-004).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether model is non-null ('observed', 'inferred_from_session') or null ('unknown').
x_justification.why_present: Tracks whether model attribution came directly from the turn record, was inherited from session config, or is unknown (MVP plan §2 Decision 3, F14).

model_unknown_reason.description: Explicit reason code when model_status == 'unknown'. Null when model is known.

x_justification.why_present: Explains why a usage record lacks model attribution and whether a subsequent snapshot within the generation may replace it.

observed_usd.description: Producer-observed exact monetary cost in USD formatted as a fixed 6-decimal string (e.g. '0.014250'). Null when cost_provenance == 'unknown' (never '0.000000' for unknown cost).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff cost_provenance != 'unknown'; null iff cost_provenance == 'unknown'. '0.000000' is reserved strictly for a verified zero-cost receipt.
x_justification.why_present: Preserves exact producer-observed USD without IEEE-754 floating-point drift across JSON and Parquet (MVP plan §2 Decision 4, F14).

observed_usd_micros.description: Producer-observed exact monetary cost in integer micro-dollars (1 USD = 1,000,000 micro-dollars). Null when cost_provenance == 'unknown'.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff cost_provenance != 'unknown'; must equal the exact integer micro-dollar value of observed_usd.
x_justification.why_present: Allows direct integer aggregation in SQL/DuckDB without string parsing while matching the Parquet INT64 physical representation of DECIMAL(18, 6).
Prevents missing usage timestamps from being represented as epoch 0.

occurred_at_us.description: UTC timestamp in microseconds since Unix epoch when the usage record occurred.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff occurred_at_status == 'observed'; null iff occurred_at_status == 'not_reported'.
x_justification.why_present: Anchors token and cost time-series and rate-card effective-date lookups in EN6a.

output_tokens.description: Normalized delta of output/completion tokens during this usage record.

x_justification.why_present: Core output token component for I02 token economics and EN6a rate-card valuation.

predecessor_usage_key.description: Previous usage_key in the cumulative counter chain when counter_semantics in ['cumulative_delta', 'cumulative_monotonic_skip']. Null otherwise.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff counter_semantics in ['cumulative_delta', 'cumulative_monotonic_skip']; null otherwise.
x_justification.why_present: Provides a verifiable audit chain for cumulative token counter subtraction (accounting_v1).

pseudonym_key_id.description: Identifier of the customer-held HMAC key generation used to pseudonymize identifiers in this row (DE-004, F13).

x_justification.pseudonymization: Metadata identifier of the HMAC key version; contains no secret material.
x_justification.why_present: Tracks key rotation for customer-held pseudonymization (DE-004).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether reasoning_tokens is non-null ('observed') vs null ('included_in_output_only', 'not_supported', 'not_reported').
x_justification.why_present: Distinguishes explicit zero reasoning tokens from harnesses that fold reasoning tokens into output_tokens or do not report them (F14).

reasoning_tokens.description: Normalized delta of reasoning/thinking tokens when separately reported by the harness. Null unless reasoning_status == 'observed'.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff reasoning_status == 'observed'; null otherwise (never 0 when reasoning token breakdown is unreported).
x_justification.why_present: Measures thinking-token overhead on reasoning models without conflating unreported breakdowns with 0.

sequence_no.description: 0-based monotonic ordinal of the usage record within the session.

x_justification.why_present: Defines deterministic cumulative delta ordering within a session even when timestamps are absent.

session_key.description: Foreign key to sessions.session_key (64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256).

x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 digest under customer-held key (DE-004, F13).
x_justification.why_present: Scopes usage records to a parent session for session-level replacement and cost rollups.

signal_source.description: Observation surface that produced the usage record.

x_justification.why_present: Identifies whether token deltas came from local logs, OTel spans, or a joined dual-source record.

source_generation.description: Monotonic positive integer generation of the source extraction state.

x_justification.why_present: Enables non-append-only replacement when model attribution, cumulative token normalization, or late cost receipts update within a generation (MVP plan §2 Decision 3).

source_id.description: Pseudonymized 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the logical source root.

x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 digest under customer-held key (DE-004, F13).
x_justification.why_present: Partitions usage replacement scope by source root.

total_tokens.description: Exact sum of input_uncached_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-negative integer; must equal the sum of the four component token deltas.
x_justification.why_present: Pre-validated total token delta for fast rollups and arithmetic consistency checks (I02).

usage_key.description: Globally unique 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 primary key of the usage record, derived from (session_key, sequence_no, usage_ordinal).

x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 digest under customer-held key (DE-004, F13).
x_justification.why_present: Primary key for usage deduplication, cumulative delta chaining, and snapshot replacement.

title: fact-export-v1 usage table row
x_invariants: (cost_provenance == 'harness_observed_exact' || cost_provenance == 'provider_receipt_exact') <=> (observed_usd != null && observed_usd_micros != null && cost_unknown_reason == null)
cost_provenance == 'unknown' <=> (observed_usd == null && observed_usd_micros == null && cost_unknown_reason != null)
